answer: A payout is split so that 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The cedar schedule is applied in prism and umber exposes each instalment. An farming party thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1858 identities would post 1517 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
